format: glTF 2.0 binary; Draco geometry; embedded JPEG and PNG textures
source: Team-requested spacesuit developed from the user-approved generated full-body reference with local TRELLIS.2 reconstruction and Blender/Python refinement. This is not the removed EVOVA asset or the NASA Mark III model.
processing: Removed facial geometry and dedicated face images; reconstructed separate visor, gasket and empty dark liner. Blended Areographic pigment into original garment albedo; protected chest UVs during mesh reduction; compressed geometry and textures.
logo: Areographic artwork used during the team's local suit design session; muted and integrated into the garment color map. No separate patch/background mesh.
limitations: Static, unrigged visual prototype. No walking or seated animation. Front reference contains baked illumination; rear/side details are reconstructed, not measured. No human face is included.
